text.text: Trinity Heating & Cooling is beyond amazing! I work in the Real Estate and Property Management business, and work with many HVAC contractors. Nabeel and his team are phenomenal. Do not think twice about contacting them for any heating  and cooling issues. You will thank me later. They are extremely professional, have great communication, fast installation time, and try to fit your needs into their schedule. Not to mention the best prices in town. We are truly blessed to have had them help our family with our new furnace/AC installation.

text.text: We selected Trinity based upon our prior experience using them. Originally I used them to install a new system on a condo our son bought.  This time, they installed a completely new system at our primary residence including the furnace and exterior heat pump. The process only took one day, the price was extremely competitive and the service was excellent. I would use them again and recommend their company.
